scientific_integrity: A self-contained analytic proof and independently replayable numerical checks are provided. No independent audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal unit-norm sampling rows, consecutive Fourier frequencies, an immovable N-point critical grid, and exactly one additional point and one known-position adversarial erasure; the theorem makes no assertion about arbitrary frames, different frequencies, or multiple redundant nodes. Comparison literature is not exhaustive. Numerical tests support but do not prove the all-N theorem.
title: A sharp midpoint rule and quadratic erasure penalty for one redundant Fourier sample
